item.title: Plasticity of working methods in the digital workplace
item.content:encoded:
Florence Laval, Université de Poitiers

Anass Mawadia, Université de Poitiers

Aurélie Dudézert, IMT-BS

Nathalie Mitev, University of Münster

This special issue focuses on the plasticity of working methods in the digital workplace, examining how organizations and individuals adapt their work practices in response to digital technologies and transformations. The issue explores the flexibility, malleability, and evolution of work methods as they are shaped by digital tools, platforms, and organizational contexts.

Potential topics

  • Plasticity of working methods in digital environments
  • Digital workplace practices and adaptability
  • Evolution of work methods in response to digital transformation

Timeline

  • February 3, 2024: Deadline for submitting an abstract to the workshop organized at the AIM Conference
  • April 3, 2024: Response to the authors for participation in the workshop
  • May 27, 2024: Preparatory workshop to support the authors and offer them constructive feedback in order to improve the articles before submission
  • September 1, 2024: Deadline for submission of manuscripts for the special issue of the journal
  • October 15, 2024: Response to the authors
  • November 30, 2024: Deadline to submit the final version
